name: BlissWorldModel - Advisory (UK) - (1B/1C) - CC + M
structure: CHECK(connected: end | new: INVITE(note x1)(accepted: MSG x3 | not: end))

variants.body: Hey {FIRST_NAME}, I'm Akhil from Blissgrowth, a UK venture studio. Our founders built Yieldify (sold to Publicis) and Reachdesk ($225M valuation). We're working on our next company in property and given your experience, we'd love for you to come on as an advisor. Would you be interested?

variants.body:
Thanks for connecting, {FIRST_NAME}.

Having built Yieldify and Reachdesk, our founders know how much a business depends on having the right data to hand. In property, everything you need on a piece of land sits scattered across public records, planning portals, flood maps and geospatial sources, and it's a nightmare to get hold of.

We're building {IDEA_PLAIN}.

We'd love to show you what we're thinking. And as mentioned, we're looking for advisors to help us on this journey. Open to a short call?
